subtitle: Bring in your bank statements, match each line to the books, and let rules sort the regular ones.
inboxZeroHint: Every statement line is settled. New ones show up here after an import.
readOnly: You can see this line, but settling it needs permission to change money.
suggestionsHint: These entries in the books have the same amount on this account, close to this date.
noSuggestions: Nothing in the books fits yet
noSuggestionsHint: No entry of this amount is near this date. Categorize it to record it now.
transferFeeHint: The bank fee on this line is recorded separately as a bank charge.
postNowHint: Otherwise it's saved as a draft for someone to post later.
draftOnly: It will be saved as a draft. Someone who can post to the books finishes it.
ignoreHint: For lines that aren't real money, like a bank's balance note. You can bring it back later.
settledMatched: This line is matched to the books.
settledAwaiting: A transaction was made for this line. It's matched once that transaction is posted.
matchedBy_AMOUNT_DATE: Matched automatically by amount and date.
unmatchBody: The line goes back to review. Any transaction it created stays; void it separately if it's wrong.
ignoredHint: This line is left out. Bring it back to settle it.
makeRule: Make a rule from this line
makeRuleHint: Lines like this one will be categorized for you next time.
noImportsHint: Download a CSV or Excel statement from your bank and bring it in here.
rowError_INVALID_DATE: The date isn't in the chosen format
savedFormatsHint: Pick one when importing, and the columns are filled in for you.
deleteFormatBody: Past imports stay as they are.
rulesHint: Rules look at new lines and sort the ones whose text contains certain words. The first rule that fits wins.
noRulesHint: Make one for regular payments, like rent or a supplier, so they never need reviewing.
deleteRuleBody: Lines it already sorted stay as they are.
ruleDialogHint: When a statement line fits, it's recorded in this category.
whenContainsHint: Plain words, not case-sensitive. “daraz” also finds “DARAZ BD LTD”.
autoPost: Post to the books straight away
autoPostHint: Without this, the rule makes drafts for someone to check.
ruleIncomplete: Give the rule a name, the words to look for, and a category.
ruleBadAmount: Enter a positive amount, or leave it empty.
ruleBadPriority: Priority is a whole number from 0 to 10,000.
noAccess: Importing statements needs permission to change money.
importSubtitle: Upload the CSV or Excel file from your bank. You'll check the columns before anything is saved.
dropFile: Drop the statement here, or click to choose
dropFileHint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to 10 MB
wrongFileType: Choose a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
fileTooBig: That file is over 10 MB. Download a shorter date range from your bank.
useFormatHint: Fills in the columns for a bank you've imported from before.
detectColumns: Work out the columns for me
headerRowHint: Some banks put a few lines of details above the table.
directionColumnHint: Only if the amount has no minus sign and another column says Dr or Cr.
finishMapping: Choose the date column and the amount columns to see what will be imported.
balanceGapsHint: Rows whose running balance doesn't follow from the row before, which can mean missing rows.
someRowsUnreadable: Some rows can't be read with these columns
saveFormat: Save these columns as a format
importStarted: Importing. Lines appear in To review as soon as they're read.
